test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I used to eat into / in the evening / when my parents / were on night shifts.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition "**into**" instead of "**in**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I used to eat in the evening**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** *"**I used to eat in t**__he evening when my parents were on night shifts."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "when my parents"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "in the evening"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "were on night shifts"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 2.
